review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Each card is one Boolean choice; both faces contribute opposite literals. Pairwise coprimality means at most one chosen face contains each prime. Sequential-counter2SAT encoding makes each prime group linear size instead of quadratic, including primes on both faces of the same card. Iterative Tarjan rejects any variable sharing SCC with its complement, and SPF removes repeated powers.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
